create_direct_optimizer: create a direct trajectory optimizer with a Mujoco model and configuration length
set_optimizer_data: set optimizer data with configuration, sensor measurements, sensor masks, force measurements, and time for each timestep
configure_optimizer_noise: configure optimizer noise with process and sensor standard deviation arrays
run_optimizer_settings: run optimizer settings with sensor flags, force flags, iteration limits, and tolerance parameters
optimize_trajectory: optimize the trajectory and print cost and status after optimization completes
